title: Invalid model
why: Shows that both an empty Model and an over-long Model are rejected.

steps.does: POST …/flight/aircraft with Name 'Bad Model Jet', Model '' (empty), ManufacturingYear 2015; then repeat with a 51-character Model 'ABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJK'

expect: Both requests are rejected with a validation error on Model. No aircraft is created.
